normalized.result: Yes, that's a nice touch and it matches what I'd want. Coming in with nothing saved yet, I saw a friendly "Your library is ready" message inviting me to save my first link, with a button to do it — rather than a blank grid or a search box and filters that'd do nothing. That's reassuring for a first-timer like me; it tells me what to do next instead of leaving me staring at an empty screen wondering if something's broken. Holding back the search and filters until I actually have things to search makes sense too. This is good.
